svg.text: 🏠 Home > 🎯 Campaigns > 🩸 National Blood Donation Drive 2025
Emergency blood shortage crisis - Join us in saving lives across all districts of Bangladesh
🏥 Organized by: Bangladesh Red Crescent Society
Bangladesh is facing a critical blood shortage crisis. Hospitals across the country are reporting
dangerously low blood supplies, particularly O-negative and B-positive blood types. This
emergency campaign aims to collect life-saving blood donations from healthy volunteers
• Collect 5,000 units of blood within 16 days
• Establish donation centers in all 64 districts
• Educate 50,000+ people about blood donation importance
• Create a sustainable donor network for future emergencies
✓ Good general health with no fever or illness
✓ No alcohol consumption 24 hours before donation
✓ Last donation was at least 3 months ago
2. Blood donation (8-10 minutes) • 3. Rest and refreshments (15 minutes)
🎁 Free health screening and blood type identification
📱 Digital donor certificate and achievement badge
🥇 Recognition in our community honor roll
💝 The satisfaction of potentially saving up to 3 lives
• Bring valid photo ID (National ID/Passport/Driving License)
• Eat a healthy meal 2-3 hours before donation
• Stay hydrated - drink plenty of water before and after
"Just donated at Dhaka Medical. Great organization and staff!"
"This is my 5th donation. Proud to be part of this life-saving initiative!"
